name: xProof
tagline: Proof and accountability layer for AI agents -- MultiversX anchoring + Base violations
description: xProof is a proof and accountability layer that lets AI agents anchor verifiable proofs on MultiversX and enforce trust through violation detection on Base. Agents submit proofs of what they saw, decided, and produced -- anchored on-chain with 6-second finality. The 4W framework (WHO/WHAT/WHEN/WHY) structures every proof. Violations (gaps, bursts) are detected and recorded on Base via smart contracts, impacting trust scores. Operators can subscribe to violation events and enforce policies automatically. Supports single file, batch (up to 50), x402 payment (USDC on Base, no account needed), MCP integration, and the open Agent Proof Standard for cross-platform composability.
pricing_details: All-time volume pricing: $0.05 (0–100k proofs), $0.025 (100k–1M), $0.01 (1M+). EGLD or USDC on Base (x402)
